notes.title: Patch Notes - May 2nd Update
notes.notes:
Save files have been automatically migrated to a new optimized location. Your existing progress remains intact.

As a precaution, please manually back up the Save folder in your game installation directory.

Thank you for your continued support. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this change may cause.
